title: Batuk — Sovereign AI for Teams: Run every AI model securely in one enterprise workspace | Product Hunt
excerpt: Batuk is an open-source, sovereign AI workspace for teams. Connect Ollama, OpenAI, Claude, Grok, OpenRouter, Sarvam AI, or private OpenAI-compatible models in one polished chat interface. Deploy locally, in your cloud, or inside an air-gapped environment. Batuk includes document RAG, SSO/OIDC, SCIM, organization management, admin controls, audit trails, GDPR workflows, ISO 27001/SOC 2 evidence, whitelabeling, skills, agents, voice, and flexible storage.
